title: Law firm or in-house legal team

tasks.title: Contract first read
tasks.when: a contract arrives and someone must say what to negotiate
steps: List the parties, the term, the money and the termination clauses.
Mark every clause that differs from the firm's standard positions.
Write the three points to negotiate first, with the clause numbers.
checks: ends with three points to negotiate

examples.input: Clause 9: either party may terminate with 10 days notice.

tasks.title: Deadlines from a court letter
tasks.when: a letter from a court or an authority arrives
steps: Find every date and every period counted from service.
Count each deadline and say from which day it is counted.
List who must do what by when.
checks: says from which day each period is counted

examples.input: You have 20 days from service (served 3 March).
